selection_process: The NICL AO selection process consists of the following stages:
Phase-I Preliminary Examination Phase-II Main Examination Interview Final Merit List Pre-Employment Medical Examination
The Phase-I Preliminary Examination will be conducted online for 100 marks with a duration of 60 minutes. Each section has a separate time limit.
Candidates must qualify in each section by securing the cut-off marks decided by NICL. Approximately 15 times the number of vacancies
may be shortlisted for the Main Examination.
The Main Examination also includes a 30-mark English Descriptive Test of 30 minutes.
The Descriptive Test is qualifying in nature. Its marks will not be counted for shortlisting candidates for the Interview or for final selection.

There is a penalty for wrong answers in the objective tests of both Phase-I and Phase-II. One-fourth of the marks assigned to a question will be deducted for each wrong answer. No penalty is applied to unanswered questions.

Candidates shortlisted after the Phase-II Main Examination will be called for Interview. Final selection will be based on the marks secured in the Main Examination Objective Test and Interview in the ratio of 80:20.

Age will be calculated as on 01 October 2026. Check all information carefully before clicking Complete Registration because changes will not be permitted afterwards. Keep the registered email address and mobile number active throughout the recruitment process. Upload the photograph, signature, left thumb impression and handwritten declaration exactly as prescribed. Keep a printout of the submitted online application and fee e-Receipt. Selected Administrative Officers will initially be on probation for one year. The probation period may be extended as per company rules. During probation, officers are required to pass the non-life Licentiate Examination conducted by the Insurance Institute of India for confirmation of service.

content_sections.text: NICL has announced 321 tentative Administrative Officer vacancies . Of these, 200 are for Generalist Officers and 121 are for Specialist Officers.

content_sections.heading: NICL AO Eligibility Criteria 2026
content_sections.text: Candidates must satisfy the required age and educational qualification conditions as on the dates prescribed by NICL. The educational qualification must be possessed as on 01 October 2026 . The required qualification should be from a recognized Indian University approved by UGC or a recognized institute approved by AICTE, as applicable.

rows.qualification: Graduate or Post Graduate in any stream from a recognized University with at least 60% marks. SC/ST/PwBD candidates require at least 55% marks.
Chartered Accountant (ICAI) or Cost and Management Accountant, along with Graduation/Post Graduation in any discipline with at least 60% marks; 55% for SC/ST/PwBD.
Graduate or Post Graduate in Law from a recognized University with at least 60% marks; 55% for SC/ST/PwBD.
B.E./B.Tech./M.E./M.Tech in Computer Science or Information Technology, or MCA, with at least 60% marks; 55% for SC/ST/PwBD.

B.E./B.Tech./M.E./M.Tech in Automobile Engineering; OR Engineering degree/postgraduate degree in any branch along with a Diploma of at least one year in Automobile Engineering. Minimum 60% marks; 55% for SC/ST/PwBD.
Graduate/Post Graduate in Engineering in a discipline other than the IT and Automobile disciplines specified in the advertisement, with at least 60% marks; 55% for SC/ST/PwBD.
ACS/FCS from ICSI along with Graduation/Post Graduation in any discipline with at least 60% marks; 55% for SC/ST/PwBD.
Four-year Graduate degree or Post Graduate qualification in Agriculture, Agricultural Biotechnology or Agricultural Engineering with at least 60% marks; 55% for SC/ST/PwBD.

content_sections.heading: NICL AO Salary 2026
content_sections.text: Selected candidates will be appointed as Administrative Officer (Scale-I) . The starting basic pay is ₹82,485 per month . Selected officers will also be eligible for applicable benefits under company rules, including New Pension Scheme benefits governed by PFRDA, Gratuity, Leave Travel Subsidy, Medical Benefits, Group Personal Accident Insurance and company or leased accommodation as per norms.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for NICL AO Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Eligible candidates can apply online for NICL AO Recruitment 2026 from 08 October to 28 October 2026 . Applications submitted through any other mode will not be accepted. Open the official NICL recruitment section. Open the NICL AO Recruitment 2026 online application link. Select Click here for New Registration . Enter your name, contact details and email address. Note the Provisional Registration Number and Password generated by the system. Complete the required personal, educational, category and other details. Upload the photograph, signature, left thumb impression and handwritten declaration in the prescribed format. Preview and verify the complete application carefully. Click Complete Registration only after verifying all details. Pay the applicable application fee online. Submit the application. Save and print the application form and e-Receipt for future reference. Important: Candidates can apply for only one discipline . In case of multiple applications, only the latest valid completed application will be retained and fees paid for other registrations will be forfeited.

content_sections.heading: NICL AO Photo and Signature Size 2026
content_sections.text: Candidates must upload a photograph, signature, left thumb impression and handwritten declaration while filling the NICL AO application form. The photograph should be a recent passport-style colour photograph. A light-coloured, preferably white background should be used. The preferred dimensions are 200 × 230 pixels. The file size should be between 20 KB and 50 KB. The candidate's face should be clearly visible. Caps, hats and dark glasses are not permitted. Religious headwear is permitted if it does not cover the face. In addition to the uploaded photograph, candidates will also be required to capture and upload a live photograph using a webcam or mobile phone during the online application process. Sign on white paper using a black ink pen. Preferred dimensions: 140 × 60 pixels. File size: 10 KB to 20 KB. The signature must be the candidate's own signature. Signatures in CAPITAL LETTERS will not be accepted. The handwritten declaration must be written by the candidate in English using black ink and should not be written in capital letters. Declaration Text: “I, ___________ (Name of the candidate), hereby declare that all information submitted by me in the application form is correct, true and valid. I will present the supporting documents as and when required.”

content_sections.text: If your NICL AO photograph, signature, thumb impression or handwritten declaration does not meet the required upload size, you can resize and compress the image before submitting the application. Link the “FreeJobAlert Image Resizer” anchor above to your existing FreeJobAlert Image Resizer tool. faq.question: Q1. Is NICL AO Recruitment 2026 notification released?
faq.answer: Yes. National Insurance Company Limited has released the detailed NICL AO Recruitment 2026-27 advertisement for Administrative Officer Scale-I posts.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in NICL AO Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 321 tentative vacancies, including 200 Generalist and 121 Specialist Administrative Officer posts.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply for NICL AO Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the online application is 28 October 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the qualification for NICL AO Generalist 2026?
faq.answer: Generalist candidates must have a Graduate or Post Graduate degree in any stream with at least 60% marks. SC/ST/PwBD candidates require at least 55% marks.

faq.question: Q5. What is the NICL AO age limit 2026?
faq.answer: The basic age limit is 21 to 30 years as on 01 October 2026. Category-wise relaxation is available according to the detailed advertisement.

faq.question: Q6. What is the NICL AO salary 2026?
faq.answer: The starting basic pay is ₹82,485 per month. Total monthly emoluments are approximately ₹1,14,000 in Metropolitan Centres, along with applicable benefits.

faq.question: Q7. What is the NICL AO application fee?
faq.answer: The fee is ₹250 for SC/ST/PwBD candidates and ₹1,000 for all other candidates, including the applicable intimation charges and GST.

faq.question: Q8. What is the NICL AO photo size?
faq.answer: The preferred photograph dimensions are 200 × 230 pixels, and the file size should be between 20 KB and 50 KB.

faq.question: Q9. What is the NICL AO signature size?
faq.answer: The preferred signature dimensions are 140 × 60 pixels, with a file size between 10 KB and 20 KB.
